purpose: Allow PR workflow self-triggers to be removed without losing review safety: common action-pin-only changes are covered only when the exact candidate action spec is exercised by the central Control Plane, deliberate self-trigger removal is recognized as bounded topology debt reduction, and all other workflow logic changes must still wake their own domain verifier through a relevant changed source path.
laws: If a changed workflow still wakes on its own definition file, its existing verifier remains the proof path.
If a changed workflow no longer self-wakes, a pin-only update is allowed only when its added exact action spec is present in and therefore exercised by the candidate central Control Plane workflow.
Action-family membership alone is never sufficient proof for a reduced workflow; an unexercised exact pin fails closed.
Removing only the workflow's own path entry from pull_request.paths is allowed only when the workflow keeps pull_request enabled and retains at least one non-workflow domain path.
Any other workflow logic change that does not self-wake must be paired with a changed non-workflow path that wakes the current workflow verifier.
Added or deleted workflow definitions without a verifiable proof path fail closed.
Unknown diff semantics or missing central proof fail closed.
